steps.content: Script Back to School Cast OwO, Lynn Time Sunny afternoon Location Eastside High School Lynn: Don't, don't go through here... We will be stopped... OwO: Hum... I am the world's most amazing, majestic, and invincible little genius OwO! OwO: There is no place where Lord OwO would not be welcome, so feel free to come with me! Lynn: I... Ah!

A loud explosion resounded through Eastside High School, followed by a firework in the sky with the image of a pink-haired high school girl. OwO: Woo-ah-! What a special firework! Who did that? OwO: Uh-huh, Lord OwO suddenly remembered that the crew is still missing a pyrotechnician! OwO: You're a student, and so is she! I'm sure you can recruit her in! Lynn: I, I can't do it!
